verifications.claim: Lani Daniels defeated Shadasia Green by a ninth-round TKO.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Lani Daniels beat Shadasia Green by technical knockout in the 9th round'; R5: 'upset TKO loss to Lani Daniels... in the ninth'

verifications.claim: Lani Daniels claimed the Ring, WBO, and IBF super middleweight world titles.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1, R3, R5: 'IBF & WBO'; R2: implies super middleweight titles held by Green; no mention of Ring title in any reference
verifications.reasoning: References support WBO and IBF but make no mention of Ring title.

verifications.claim: Lani Daniels is a 37-year-old New Zealander.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '37 years... New Zealand'; R5: 'Daniels, 37... New Zealander'

verifications.claim: Lani Daniels has a boxing record of 12-4-2.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: References state pre-fight record as 11-4-2 (R2, R3); no mention of 12-4-2.

verifications.claim: Shadasia Green was transported to a hospital by stretcher after the stoppage.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'taken from the ring on a stretcher and rushed to further medical care'; update notes conscious in locker room
verifications.reasoning: Stretcher and medical care supported, but hospital not explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: Lani Daniels def. Shadasia Green (TKO, Round 9).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Lani Daniels beat Shadasia Green by technical knockout in the 9th round'; R5: 'TKO loss to Lani Daniels'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match to result and round.

verifications.claim: Lani Daniels won the WBO, IBF, and Ring Magazine Female Super Middleweight titles.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1, R3, R5: 'IBF & WBO World Female Super Middleweight Titles'; no Ring Magazine mention
verifications.reasoning: WBO and IBF supported; Ring Magazine not mentioned.

verifications.claim: The event was MVPW 02: Baumgardner vs. Shin.
